fields.description: The lesson this checkpoint belongs to.
fields.label: Lesson

fields.description: Which video block on the lesson this interrupts. Keyed by the block's stable key rather than its position, so reordering the lesson never moves a checkpoint onto the wrong video.
fields.label: Block Key

fields.description: Stable identifier, copied verbatim when a version is cloned. A learner who has already answered this checkpoint is not asked again after a minor edit.
fields.label: Checkpoint Key

fields.description: How far into the video to interrupt, in seconds. Never sent to the player up front — a list of these is a map of exactly where to skip to.
fields.label: At (Seconds)

fields.description: Count this towards the lesson score as well as gating playback.
fields.label: Counts Toward Score

fields.description: Asked over the paused video. Keep it short — the learner is mid-lesson.
fields.label: Question

fields.description: Tick the correct option. It is never sent to the browser.
fields.label: Options

fields.description: Pause playback until the question is answered. Untick to show it as a non-blocking prompt.
fields.label: Pause the Video

fields.description: Let the learner dismiss the question without answering.
fields.label: Allow Skip

fields.description: Tries before the explanation is shown and the video continues anyway. A learner trapped in a loop abandons the course and it becomes a support ticket, so this never blocks forever — the miss is recorded instead.
fields.label: Attempts Before Moving On

fields.description: How far to rewind after a wrong answer so the learner sees that part again. Those seconds are already credited, so the cost is time rather than score.
fields.label: Rewind on Wrong (Seconds)
